download_light_whoami_model: download a light_whoami model of a specific type to the Parlai model directory
check_model_built_status: check whether a light_whoami model of a given type and version is already built
get_model_directory: get the Parlai model directory path for a given datapath
download_model_tgz: download the model.tgz archive for a light_whoami model type using download_models
review_download_with_model_type: review the download_with_model_type function to understand how it downloads and checks light_whoami models
